newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Half of Venezuelan stocks foreign owned - paper.
newsitem.headline: Half of Venezuelan stocks foreign owned - paper.

text.p: Half of Venezuela's listed companies are in the hands of foreign investors and the degree of foreign participation in the economy is still rising, according to a study reported in leading daily El Universal.

"Perhaps the most important fact to assimilate is that foreign investment already dominates ... (and) is here to stay," a report by brokerage firm and market analysts Marino Recio Asoc said, El Universal reported.
"We are part of the global dollar economy," the study said.

Venezuela's stock market has so far been the region's worst-performing this year. But in 1996, highlighted by a $1 billion global share offer by national telephone company CANTV and the foreign takeover of nearly half the banking sector, the bolsa soared over 100 percent in dollar terms.
